subject: T3: learned ask-gate + auto-promote comparator
description: Phase 2 (blocked on T1). Train a learned classifier on .graph/ask-journal.jsonl ground truth (what the user actually chose: ask vs the prediction being correct), mirroring scripts/edge-clf-fit.js (logistic regression, train/holdout split, metrics.jsonl). Run it in SHADOW mode alongside the live heuristic — log shadow_decision + shadow_conf on each ask-journal row without deciding yet (mirror lib/judge.js shadowFields). THE NEW PIECE: an auto-promote comparator that, on each training cycle, computes the heuristic's accuracy and the learned model's holdout accuracy on the SAME rows, and flips the live decision source from heuristic→learned automatically once learned beats heuristic by a margin over a stable window. This auto-promotion does not exist for the edge classifier today (promotion is manual) — build it generically enough that the edge-clf could reuse it later, but scope the deliverable to the ask-gate.

summary: Learned ask-gate (Phase 2) done. scripts/ask-clf-fit.js (ESM logistic regression on .graph/ask-journal.jsonl, index%5 holdout, graceful skip on missing/sparse/single-class/unlabeled — no fabricated labels; ground truth = realized-correct decision; metrics row carries learned_accuracy AND heuristic_accuracy on the SAME holdout). scripts/ask-clf-predict.js (CJS, null⇒heuristic fallback). lib/promotion.js (generic shadow→enforce comparator: window+margin, monotone latch). lib/ask-promote.js (reads metrics.jsonl, runs comparator, persists .graph/ask-clf/mode.json where ask-gate reads it). lib/ask-gate.js: added source switch + shadow_decision/shadow_conf logging on recall-based verdicts ONLY — hard-overrides short-circuit before it, so the learned source can never license an irreversible/outward action; heuristic stays live until auto-promotion flips mode to 'learned'. Tests: test/ask-clf.test.js 28/28 pass (fit-on-seed, all degrade paths, shadow logging stays heuristic, comparator promote/stay/stability/insufficient, end-to-end mode flip switching the live decision); ask-gate.test.js regression 25/25 still pass. Full suite 119/131 — the 12 failures are pre-existing daemon/port + edge-clf-fixture integration tests (judge-journal etc. fail identically on clean main 971b28c), unrelated to this change. Committed as 5bc5314 on orch/attempt/0b5a907e-b58e-41cd-892b-4c0ca8d27099-3 (1 ahead of base).
